36.name: Heather Hoffman
36.overview: When a young father is murdered in his apartment, investigators learn the victim was involved in a bitter custody battle prior to his death.

36.name: Elizabeth Carserino
36.overview: The search for a missing elderly woman turns into a murder investigation after police discover a grisly crime scene. As authorities search for the last person to see her alive, they follow a digital trail that will expose a cold-hearted betrayal.

36.name: Deborah Frazier
36.overview: An apparent home invasion leaves a woman shot, her boyfriend dead, and police searching for two masked intruders. But when inconsistencies in her story start piling up, police realize the woman at the center might not be the victim she claims to be.

36.name: Brookey Lee West
36.overview: When the decomposed body of a woman is discovered inside a Las Vegas storage unit, investigators follow the clues to an unlikely culprit. A chilling tale of murder unravels, rooted in long-buried family secrets and eerie ties to the occult.

36.name: Samantha Rabon
36.overview: After South Carolina authorities locate a burned and abandoned vehicle, they are led to a brutal crime scene at a local church leader's home. Their small community is divided when an unforeseen perpetrator is found responsible.

36.name: Kimethia Coleman
36.overview: A frantic 911 call captures a man's final moments after a brutal knife attack in his home. As their only eyewitness keeps changing her story, investigators dig deep to uncover a crumbling relationship and the sinister truth behind a vicious murder.

36.name: Evelyn Zigerelli-Henderson
36.overview: When a retired Dauphin County sheriff is found burned to death, investigators zero in on his wife's bizarre behavior. They must quickly determine whether the death was the result of a mental health crisis or a malicious plan to kill.

36.name: Stella Lacy
36.overview: A missing family man is found murdered in his car near his home in New York. When evidence of a secret affair is exposed, detectives unravel a chilling conspiracy orchestrated by individuals close to him and a mastermind driven by greed.

36.name: Julie Harper
36.overview: A respected family man is found shot to death in his upscale California home. As detectives race to find his killer, a startling confession exposes a web of lies, allegations of abuse, and a marriage pushed to its breaking point.

36.name: Trista Hrabak
36.overview: A farmer is gunned down inside his Barron County, Wisconsin home in what appears to be a planned hit. As investigators search for answers, they turn to an unstable ex whose plot to kill shocks the rural community.

36.name: Olivia Moody
36.overview: A beloved mother is fatally shot after a feud between two other women escalates into a group fight. Pine Bluff authorities interview witnesses to uncover the shooter's true motive as public opinion on the case grows increasingly divided.

36.name: Jennifer Sweeney
36.overview: Just months after a shooting nearly takes her life, a New Jersey woman is reported missing. Fearing her original attacker has returned to finish the job, investigators race to expose an elaborate murder plot and an obsessive killer

36.name: Natalie Cochran
36.overview: When a businessman collapses in his home under mysterious circumstances, investigators unearth a sinister plot to cover up a multimillion-dollar Ponzi scheme-and the woman who will stop at nothing to keep it hidden.

36.name: Jacqueline Johnson-Cabrera
36.overview: The family of a respected corrections officer is shattered when they find him in his bed with a fatal gunshot wound. Florida authorities uncover a disgraced former officer whose jealousy and obsession lead to murder.

36.name: Antonetta Stevens
36.overview: When a young woman dies from injuries received in an apparent assault, detectives in Georgia open a homicide investigation that reveals infidelity, heartbreak, and the shocking video of a revenge plot gone horribly wrong.

36.name: Nicole Nachtman
36.overview: A quiet Florida suburb is shaken by a couple's double homicide, launching detectives into a tense investigation. When evidence points to someone close to the victims, authorities unmask a killer with a tenuous hold on reality.

36.name: Tammy Moorer
36.overview: A South Carolina family is shattered by the sudden disappearance of their daughter just before she planned to launch her dream career. Investigators track her last known movements that will expose a vengeance fueled by a jealous obsession.

36.name: LaFrieda Todd
36.overview: When a feud between coworkers in a busy South Carolina restaurant erupts in gunfire, detectives must decide whether the shooting was an act of self-defense or a calculated murder.

36.name: Nikki Hillrich
36.overview: When a California sales executive is found shot to death in a parking garage, police initially think it could be a robbery gone wrong. The investigation soon uncovers shocking physical evidence that reveals forbidden liaisons and a deadly scheme.

36.name: Yessenia Sanchez
36.overview: A Miami-Dade police officer fights for his life after he is shot in front of his parents' house. When surveillance video of the shooting surfaces, detectives home in on a tumultuous relationship marked by violence.

36.name: Lara Paige Conley
36.overview: After the brutal murder of a loving grandmother, investigators in Kentucky look to those closest to the victim to uncover the killer. As they examine the evidence, they expose a volatile relationship and a devastating betrayal.

36.name: Jennifer Reali
36.overview: When a woman is shot by a masked gunman in the parking lot of a Colorado Springs recreation center, the evidence points to a premeditated attack. As detectives try to identify the gunman, they uncover a secret affair and a conspiracy to kill.

36.name: Jasmine Femia
36.overview: Beaufort officers suspect foul play after a beloved family man was shot to death while taking a call from an unknown number. The investigation will uncover a string of evidence that exposes a deadly plan to gain control over a toxin.

36.name: Sarah Ramey
36.overview: A series of house fires erupts across Tacoma, Washington, sparking fears of a serial arsonist. When one blaze takes a man's life, investigators rely on video evidence and eyewitness accounts to bring the killer to justice.
